about: [C1] after the critic (M4): ESC on the opening stills as a real browser has it. Headless Chrome keeps the pointer lock and hands the page every ESC; a real one takes the first ESC under the lock for itself and lets the mouse go. The play stands that first press in by letting the lock go (document.exitPointerLock, which is what the browser does), then presses the second ESC for real. After the skip: no pause card; the diner comes up, a quiet line asks for a click, the click takes the mouse. Also: a fast double tap of two real ESCs skips; a key event and the lock's loss together are one press; left without a click, the pause card comes after eight seconds. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/kit_esc.json
